messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt blocked for production (region: us-west-2)
deploy-bot: commit: 9f3b2aa (tag: v2.3.0-rc4) by @maya
deploy-bot: CI gate failed: healthcheck-service e2e flaky checks (see logs) :rotating_light:

maya: ugh, saw this hit the canary earlier in staging too. failing on the same smoke healthcheck step.
jun: linking logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9f3b2aa/build/12345 -- looks like a timeout talking to kv-cache at ~45s
lina: can we rerun the CI job? might be transient.
maya: I kicked a rebuild for the affected job, but other checks are green. the healthcheck test keeps timing out on the post-start probe.
jun: stack snippet from the failing test:
```
Error: HealthCheck failed: GET /internal/health returned 504 after 45002ms
at service/health.go:78
at runtime/net.go:213
```
jun: this smells like a kv-cache connection flake under higher connection churn.

srini: infra: our dedicated pool saw a rollout last night, nothing obvious on infra metrics. rolling averages show p99 latency up ~120ms but not 50s.
maya: could be a protocol mismatch with the new model runtime in this build. the commit includes a small change to connection retry timings.

lina: options: 1) pin production to previous stable (tag v2.2.9) and abort this deploy, 2) hotfix the retry in the branch and re-run CI, 3) force-unblock (not recommended).
jun: +1 to pin until we understand root cause. production traffic should stay steady; we can do a canary rollback to v2.2.9 and watch for regressions.

maya: agree. I'll prepare a pin PR and a rollback plan. can someone schedule a quick canary window?

srini: I can run the rollback. ETA 10-15m once PR is merged. please annotate the release notes.

maya: created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pin-to-v2.2.9-2042002468 with description and rollforward instructions.

deploy-bot: Note: blocked deploy metadata:
- env: production
- target tag: v2.3.0-rc4
- blocked_by: CI gate (healthcheck-service e2e)
- blocking_job: build/12345/healthcheck
- logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9f3b2aa/build/12345/logs

oncall-bot: paging oncall (srini) because deploy blocked in prod.

srini: starting rollback to v2.2.9 canary now. will cut a canary at 10% traffic and monitor p50/p95/p99 + health checks.

lina: I'll update the release board and add a short note to #incidents in case partners ping.

maya: after canary stabilizes, we'll either merge the pin PR or rerun the CI for rc4 once we have a hotfix.

jun: if canary shows the same healthcheck flake on v2.2.9, then we need to escalate to infra and treat this as infra incident.

srini: canary deploy started (canary-id: c-2042002468-1). monitoring hooks enabled. Will report within 15m. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy action update: rollback initiated to v2.2.9 (initiated by srini). Canary ID c-2042002468-1.

srini: canary looks good at 10m: healthcheck success rate 99.8%, latencies back to expected baseline. no crashes.

maya: good signal. i'll merge the pin PR and schedule a re-run of the failing CI with extra debug enabled on the healthcheck test to capture additional headers/timings.

lina: note for release notes: production pinned to v2.2.9 due to RC4 healthcheck failures; investigation ongoing.

jun: leaving a TODO to follow up with the runtime team about retry timing changes in commit 9f3b2aa.

deploy-bot: Final state: rollout blocked -> rollback to v2.2.9 successful. Production at v2.2.9.

maya: thanks everyone. will post a short postmortem draft after we finish root cause debugging. :coffee:
